items.name: HL · 8 p.m. run (hardened)
items.what: The 2.3 tomorrow run with a plan for every failure: the weather lookup resumes with "unknown", each courier booking alerts Tolu and retries 3 times every 15 minutes, a failed customer text is logged to the Errors tab and skipped, and the Deliveries write retries twice.
setup: Scenario settings: turn on "Allow storing of incomplete executions" (the blueprint sets it, but check). Without it, Break can't save failed runs.

Fake courier: on webhook.site create a URL, set its default response status to 503 for the failure test and 201 with body {"booking_id": "CR-1001"} for recovery; paste it in place of YOUR_WEBHOOK_SITE_URL.

Message customer: replace YOUR_SMS_API_URL with your SMS (or WhatsApp) provider's send endpoint and add a keychain (HTTP · Make an API Key Auth request) with your test API key in the header the provider expects. In class you can point it at a second webhook.site URL that returns 400 for one number.

Connections: open each Google Sheets and Gmail module and choose your Harvest Lane business Google connection (0.6), then pick the spreadsheet (replace YOUR_SHEET_ID) and tab. Replace YOUR_ORDERS_SHEET_ID, YOUR_DELIVERIES_SHEET_ID and YOUR_ERRORS_SHEET_ID (they can all be the same spreadsheet).

Column letters: the blueprint assumes Orders = A order_id, B customer_id, C customer_name, D delivery_date, E fee, F status, G items_total, H total (0.4), I phone_clean, J first_name, K delivery_day, L receipt_text (2.2), M paid_at, N channel, O area, P email, Q delivery_window. If yours differ, open each Google Sheets module after import and re-pick the columns.

Tabs: Deliveries = A delivery_date, B order_id, C customer_name, D area, E phone, F courier_ref, G rain_chance. Errors = A time, B scenario, C module, D order_id, E error. Needs checking = A order_id, B status, C channel, D total, E reason.
Replace YOUR_PAYMENT_LINK and tolu@harvestlane.example. Open the Profile → Notifications page and turn on emails for errors and warnings.
items.test: Add three test orders for tomorrow (two Paid, one New), set webhook.site to 503 and Run once: Tolu gets one alert per paid order, the run shows Warning and two incomplete executions are stored. Switch webhook.site to 201: within the next retry they complete and two Deliveries rows appear. Break the weather URL (e.g. latitude=abc): rider rows say "unknown". Give one order an invalid phone so the SMS endpoint returns 400: one Errors row, the other customers still get their texts.
build: 1 · HTTP › Make a request "HTTP · Weather (Open-Meteo)": GET https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast; query latitude 7.3775, longitude 3.9470, daily precipitation_probability_max, timezone Africa/Lagos, forecast_days 2; Parse response Yes; Evaluate all states as errors Yes. (First module so it runs once a night, not once per order.)
Error handler on 1 · Resume: Status code 200; data.daily.precipitation_probability_max = [unknown, unknown].
3 · Google Sheets › Search Rows "Tomorrow's orders": Orders; filter delivery_date (D) Equal to {{formatDate(addDays(now; 1); "YYYY-MM-DD")}}.
Filter on 3→4 "Not cancelled": status Text operators: Not equal to (case insensitive) Cancelled.
4 · Router "Sort the orders" with four routes (from 2.3).
Route 1 · filter on 4→5 "Paid or standing": status Equal to Paid OR channel Equal to standing.

5 · HTTP › Make a request "HTTP · Book courier": POST YOUR_WEBHOOK_SITE_URL; Body raw JSON {"order_id": "{{3.order_id}}", "customer": "{{3.customer_name}}", "area": "{{3.area}}", "phone": "{{3.phone_clean}}", "delivery_date": "{{3.delivery_date}}"}; Parse response Yes; Evaluate all states as errors Yes.

Error handler on 5 · Gmail › Send an email "Gmail · Alert Tolu (courier)": To tolu@harvestlane.example; Subject Courier booking failed · {{3.order_id}}; Body {{error.type}}: {{error.message}} / Order {{3.order_id}} for {{3.customer_name}}, {{3.area}}. / Make will retry automatically. Check incomplete executions if this repeats. → Break: Automatically complete execution Yes, Number of attempts 3, Interval 15 minutes.

8 · Google Sheets › Add a Row "Google Sheets · Add to Deliveries": Deliveries; delivery_date {{3.delivery_date}}, order_id {{3.order_id}}, customer_name {{3.customer_name}}, area {{3.area}}, phone {{3.phone_clean}}, courier_ref {{ifempty(5.data.booking_id; "booked")}}, rain_chance {{get(1.data.daily.precipitation_probability_max; 2)}}{{if(get(1.data.daily.precipitation_probability_max; 2) = "unknown"; emptystring; "%")}}.
Error handler on 8 · Break: automatic completion Yes, 2 attempts, 15 minutes.

10 · HTTP › Make an API Key Auth request "Message customer": POST YOUR_SMS_API_URL; raw JSON {"to": "{{3.phone_clean}}", "message": "Hi {{3.first_name}}, your Harvest Lane order {{3.order_id}} arrives tomorrow, {{ifempty(3.delivery_window; "time to be confirmed")}}. Rain chance: …"}; Evaluate all states as errors Yes.

Error handler on 10 · Google Sheets › Add a Row "Log to Errors tab": Errors; time {{formatDate(now; "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm")}}, scenario HL · 8 p.m. run, module Message customer, order_id {{3.order_id}}, error {{error.type}}: {{error.message}} → Ignore.
Route 2 · filter on 4→13 "Unpaid customer order": status Equal to New AND channel Not equal to standing → 13 · Gmail › Send an email "Gmail · Payment reminder" to {{3.email}} with the payment link.
Route 3 · filter on 4→14 "Big order": total Numeric operators: Greater than 50000 → 14 · Gmail › Send an email "Gmail · Alert Tolu (big order)".

Route 4 · fallback: in the route's settings tick "Fallback route" (the blueprint carries the equivalent filter: status ≠ Paid AND channel ≠ standing AND status ≠ New AND total ≤ 50000) → 15 · Google Sheets › Add a Row "Sheets · Add to Needs checking": order_id, status, channel, total, reason Matched no route.
Scenario settings: Allow storing of incomplete executions = Yes. Schedule daily 20:00.

walk.title: Build it: an 8 p.m. run that survives Friday
walk.sample: Three orders for tomorrow · two Paid, one New · fake courier on webhook.site returning 503, then 201

steps.say: We plan on paper first: for each module, how much does it matter if it fails? Then switch on storing of incomplete executions, or Break can't save anything for later.
show: Scenario settings: Allow storing of incomplete executions ✓

steps.say: The weather lookup goes first, so it runs once a night, not once per order. It asks Open-Meteo for tomorrow's rain chance in Ibadan.
show: HTTP › Make a request · GET api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast

steps.say: Weather is nice to have, so its handler is Resume. If it fails, we substitute unknown and the run carries on.
Then the same search as 2.3: tomorrow's orders, with cancelled ones filtered off before the router.
The router keeps its four routes from 2.3: rider list, reminder, big order, and the fallback.
On the rider route, each paid order is booked with the courier's API. Tonight that's a fake on webhook.site, so we can choose when it fails.
show: Body: order_id, customer, area, phone, delivery_date

steps.say: A booking must happen tonight, so its error route first emails Tolu exactly what broke and for which order.
Then Break, with automatic retries: three attempts, fifteen minutes apart. A short outage fixes itself, with no orders lost.
A booked order goes on the Deliveries tab with the courier reference and the rain chance.
A sheet write rarely fails, usually a quota blip, so it gets Break with two retries.
Then we text the customer. The provider's key sits in a keychain, never in a header field.
show: HTTP › API Key Auth request · POST YOUR_SMS_API_URL
Hi {{3.`9`}}, your Harvest Lane order … arrives tomorrow

steps.say: One bad phone number shouldn't stop everyone else, so the error route logs it to the Errors tab.
Then Ignore. The bad one is recorded, and the other customers still get their texts. Never use Ignore on something that matters, like payments.
Now break it on purpose. With the courier on 503, you'll see Tolu's alerts and stored incomplete executions. Switch webhook.site to 201, and the next retry books them by itself.

walk.end: Run once with the courier down, read the alerts and the Warning status, then bring it back up and watch the bookings complete on their own.
